model.display_rating: 1-100 ratings are calibrated from standard deviations above/below the FBS field; rank does not determine the rating. 95+ is intentionally rare and 100 requires approximately +3.5 SD.
model.categories: Scoring 22%, Efficiency 23%, Passing 18%, Rushing 17%, Line 10%, Finishing 10%.
model.opponent_adjustment: Each game metric is standardized against the FBS field and recursively adjusted for the corresponding opponent unit strength.
model.preseason_prior: Evidence-based decay: 100%, 75%, 55%, 40%, 20%, 5%, then 0% after six qualifying FBS games.
model.fcs: FCS games can penalize underperformance but do not create artificial positive strength credit.
model.ap_rank: reference only; never enters the formula
